software-engineering/python-essentials-a.summary: Set up uv or venv, a clean project structure and Git, then read and write files with proper exception handling.

sections.heading: Focus
sections.body: Set up uv or venv, a clean project structure and Git, then read and write files with proper exception handling.

objectives: Set up an isolated environment and keep secrets in a .env file
Use functions, modules, file handling and try/except correctly
Structure a small project and commit it with Git
checkpointQuestions: How would you hand a client a project that runs on their machine first time?
What should happen when an input file is missing or malformed?

software-engineering/data-structures-jso.summary: Turn nested JSON, CSV and text extracted from PDFs and Word files into clean tables.

sections.heading: Focus
sections.body: Turn nested JSON, CSV and text extracted from PDFs and Word files into clean tables.

objectives: Choose between lists, dicts, sets and tuples and use comprehensions
Parse and flatten JSON and CSV data
Filter, group, merge and clean data in pandas, including missing values
checkpointQuestions: How would you find and handle bad rows in a client’s export?
How do you get text out of PDF and DOCX files?

software-engineering/working-with-apis-r.summary: Call REST and LLM APIs without letting timeouts, rate limits or bad responses break the job.

sections.heading: Focus
sections.body: Call REST and LLM APIs without letting timeouts, rate limits or bad responses break the job.

objectives: Use requests or httpx with auth headers and check status codes
Add timeouts, exponential backoff, rate-limit handling and pagination
Log API calls so failures can be diagnosed later
checkpointQuestions: What should happen when an API returns 429 or times out?
Where do API keys live, and how do they stay out of Git?

software-engineering/typing-pydantic-and.summary: Validate model output with Pydantic and run many calls concurrently without hitting rate limits.

sections.heading: Focus
sections.body: Validate model output with Pydantic and run many calls concurrently without hitting rate limits.

objectives: Model data with type hints and Pydantic, including custom validators
Run concurrent calls with asyncio and cap concurrency with a semaphore
Handle validation failures with a repair or retry step
checkpointQuestions: Why validate LLM output even when the prompt asks for JSON?
How do you run 50 parallel calls without hitting rate limits?

sections.heading: Focus
sections.body: Build a command-line tool that reads a file, cleans it and reports counts and errors.

objectives: Read and clean a messy input file

checkpointQuestions: What did you do with rows that could not be parsed?
How would the tool behave on a file ten times larger?

sections.body: Classify 50 support tickets concurrently into validated JSON.

objectives: Run calls concurrently with a concurrency limit
